title: finance-legal-personal-todo
content:
Quick daily scratchpad - finance/legal personal to-dos + notes

High priority
- [ ] ACME Cloud - invoice check: INV-2026-0412 (received 2026-02-22). Verify services period Feb 1-28 matches PO# 2026-187. Samir to confirm consumption report (ask in #finance). If ok, route for approval to Rita by 2026-03-01.
- [ ] Vendor X contract redline: review indemnity/limitation changes. Legal suggested caps: limit liability to fees paid in 12 months + carveouts for IP/data. My notes: push for mutual indemnity, keep DPA appendix. Send counter-redline (v3) by EOD 2026-02-28.
- [ ] Renewal reminders:
    - Segment analytics (SaaS) auto-renews 2026-05-01 — confirm whether we want to renew 12 vs 24 mo and negotiate discount. Owner: Product. Action: ping Amy (product) 2026-03-05.
    - Cloud infra reserved nodes renewal due 2026-04-15 — check Dedicated capacity usage, possibly downsize. Task: export usage dashboard + cost delta.

Medium priority
- [ ] PO follow-ups for Q1 vendor spend > $20k (list attached in Drive). Create single summary for CFO weekly update.
- [ ] Open disputes: INV-2025-389 mismatch for Vendor Y (services listed twice). Draft email to vendor with line-item breakdown.

Contract redlines notes (quick):
- Change: Section 9 (Indemnity) -> make mutual, clarify "Third party claims" definition.
- Change: Section 11 (Liability cap) -> cap = total fees paid under agreement in prior 12 months. Add carveout for gross negligence/willful misconduct.
- Add: DPA Appendix -> data retention, subprocessor list, deletion timeline (30 days post-termination).
- Ask legal: accept vendor's standard cyber insurance clause? If no, request proof of coverage >= $5M.

Invoices / AP process reminders
- Triage folder: drive://shared_drives/finance/invoices/q1-2026 (upload scanned receipts)
- Process: match invoice -> PO -> GL code -> approver. Use AP code mapping sheet (link in Confluence).
- Note: allow two business days for manual exceptions (e.g., no PO).

Follow-ups / ppl to ping
- Samir Patel: ask for consumption report + confirm PO mapping for ACME invoice.
- Rita Gonzalez: need approval for redline language before sending to vendor.
- Amy (Product): confirm Segment renewal posture.
- Procurement: check if Vendor X already has approved SOW template in contract library.

Questions / unresolved
- Is there an existing DPA template we should attach? (legal library?)
- Can we push renewal date for cloud infra by 30 days to align budget? Who owns that conversation?

Misc quick notes / scratch
- Keep invoice numbering convention sheet updated (FIN-ops).
- Attach proof-of-delivery for INV-2026-0412 if vendor provides.
- If redline stalls > 7 days, escalate to Head of Legal.

Today (2026-02-28) plan:
- morning: finish redline edits for Vendor X, upload to Drive, ping legal for quick review.
- midday: reconcile ACME invoice with PO and consumption report.
- afternoon: draft renewal note for Segment and put on Product calendar.

Notes to self: keep items short in Drive - move polished docs to shared_drives/legal or finance once ready.

Raw references (copy/paste quickly)
- INV-2026-0412, PO# 2026-187, FIN-3421, drive://shared_drives/legal/vendor-acme-cloud-contract-redline-v2.docx

-- Lena
